He said to me:

“I had heard about him, that he is great in Torah, but I knew nothing

I, what I hear from you, I did not know at all”

He said:

“I want you to give to Yisroel Ber so that there will be bread for the small children, they will have bread”

Then they said:

“We are not giving him anything, he studies Breslov books..”…

…“..You do not know that he studies Breslov books? We will not give him anything”

My children and I suffered great hunger, like in the desert

They did not want to give me bread for the children

“He studies Breslov books, we do not want him”…
